question_summary: Contractor requests approval to substitute PEX piping in lieu of the copper domestic water piping specified in Section 22 11 16 prior to placing a material order.
proposed_solution: Use PEX piping in lieu of copper for the domestic water piping system.
deadline_text: Please respond by the end of the week so we can place the order.
routing_rationale: As a substitution request with no stated cost impact, it defaults to the design professional of record for the Plumbing discipline.
